  {"step":4,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":91,"var":"hdrsz,payloadsz","code":"hdrsz = fu_struct_uswid_get_hdrsz(st); payloadsz = fu_struct_uswid_get_payloadsz(st)","note":"The declared header and payload sizes are trusted and used to position the payload stream."},
  {"step":5,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":104,"var":"priv->compression","code":"priv->compression = fu_struct_uswid_get_compression(st)","note":"For hdrver >= 3, the compression selector is read from the input and can request zlib or lzma decoding."},
  {"step":6,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":107,"var":"payload","code":"istream1 = fu_partial_input_stream_new(stream, offset + hdrsz, payloadsz); istream2 = g_converter_input_stream_new(istream1, conv); payload = fu_input_stream_read_bytes(istream2, 0, G_MAXSIZE, error)","note":"The compressed payload bytes are decompressed into a new buffer whose size is determined by the attacker-controlled stream contents."},
  {"step":7,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":129,"var":"fw2","code":"fw2 = fu_bytes_new_offset(payload, offset_tmp, payloadsz - offset_tmp, error)","note":"Each coSWID record is parsed from the decompressed payload buffer using the remaining byte count."},
  {"step":8,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_coswid_firmware_parse","line":null,"var":"CBOR fields","code":"coSWID parsing walks attacker-controlled CBOR data and materializes strings/arrays used by later consumers","note":"The nested coSWID parser consumes the payload and propagates attacker-controlled lengths and strings into firmware metadata."},
  {"step":9,"file":"llvm/lib/DebugInfo/Symbolize/Symbolize.cpp","function":"LLVMSymbolizer::DemangleName","line":685,"var":"Name","code":"if (!Name.empty() && Name.front() == '$') { char *DemangledName = swift_demangle(Name.c_str(), Name.length(), 0, 0, 0); }","note":"A symbol name beginning with '$' is handed to swift_demangle, which is the memory-safety sink reached by the crafted metadata."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote trace')
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
